items.text: Edward Jones states that eligible retiring financial advisors are offered individually tailored retirement transition plans, each of which compensates a retiring financial advisor for successfully providing client transition services under a retirement and transition agreement that generally runs five years; during the first two years the retiring advisor remains an employee and provides client transition services, retiring at the end of year two and subject to a three-year non-compete.
items.quote: Retirement Transition Plans. Eligible retiring financial advisors are offered individually tailored retirement transition plans. Each retirement transition plan compensates a retiring financial advisor for successfully providing client transition services in accordance with a retirement and transition agreement. Generally, the retirement and transition agreement is for five years. During the first two years the retiring financial advisor remains an employee and provides client transition services. The financial advisor retires at the end of year two and is subject to a non-compete agreement for three years.

items.text: Edward Jones reported that financial advisor attrition increased to 6.4% in the second quarter of 2025, primarily due to an increase in retirements, consistent with industry trends.
items.quote: Financial advisor attrition increased to 6.4% primarily due to an increase in retirements, consistent with industry trends.
items.definition: Attrition % represents the annualized number of financial advisors that left or retired from the Partnership during the period compared to the total number of financial advisors as of period end.

items.text: Edward Jones reported financial advisor attrition of 6.1% in the third quarter of 2025, attributable to a variety of factors including a rise in financial advisor departures with tenure of five years or less.
items.quote: Financial advisor attrition was 6.1% as a result of a variety of factors, including a rise in financial advisor departures with tenure of five years or less.
items.definition: Attrition % represents the annualized number of financial advisors that left or retired from the Partnership during the period compared to the total number of financial advisors as of period end.

items.text: Edward Jones maintains a comprehensive onboarding program for financial advisors, delivered through online self-paced modules, application at home office training facilities or a virtual classroom, and on-the-job training in a nearby branch office, including study for requisite examinations, financial planning learning, and in-region mentorship from field leaders and other financial advisors.
items.quote: The Partnership maintains a comprehensive onboarding program for financial advisors delivered through online self-paced modules, concentrated application in one of the Partnership's home office training facilities or a virtual classroom with their peers, and on-the-job training in their respective markets in a nearby branch office.
